END-TO-END FLOW — WHAT THE ENGINES DO AT EACH STEP
negotiated terms breach ceilings → automatic re-approval (same engine, same audit trail)
• Self-governing: risk scores route work, customer confirmations re-enter approval, backorder prompts and commissions fire from state changes — never from a button that "pretends".
• One rule engine, many entry points: builder edits, portal counters, rep acceptances and admin ceiling changes all hit the same computeRisk → requiredApprovalLevel → routeForApproval path.
• Inventory reality: split and consolidation only ever promise free stock (on-hand − planned by other orders); stock decrements when a shipment leaves; restock re-evaluates every open backorder.
• Tenant isolation: the portal is a distinct auth surface (own cookie or per-quotation token); customers can only read their own company's rows — verified by the automated suite.

• Everything configurable live (ceilings, approval ranges, plans, upsell rules, thresholds) · full audit trail · 102 automated HTTP end-to-end checks cover the official 8-step flow and the edge cases above.
